slides.0.title: Margaret River: Australia's Bordeaux
slides.0.subtitle: Level 1 · Module 5 · Lesson 1
slides.1.title: Margaret River: An Exceptional Setting
slides.1.points.0: Location: southwestern tip of Western Australia, 280 km south of Perth
slides.1.points.1: Climate: Mediterranean with Indian and Southern Ocean influence — warm dry summers, mild winters
slides.1.points.2: Rainfall: well-distributed through winter; drought stress in summer drives concentration
slides.1.points.3: Soil: gravelly loam over laterite — similar to Médoc gravel soils in Bordeaux
slides.1.points.4: Key varieties: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc, Sémillon
slides.2.title: Margaret River: The Bordeaux of Australia
slides.2.points.0: 🍷 Red wines: Cabernet Sauvignon is king — cassis, cedar, firm tannins, remarkable structure
slides.2.points.1: 🥂 White wines: Chardonnay of Burgundy-like precision; SBS (Sauvignon Blanc-Sémillon) blend world-famous
slides.2.points.2: 🌊 SBS blend: crisp tropical + herbaceous + creamy richness — an Australian original
slides.2.points.3: 🏄 Prestige producers: Leeuwin Estate (Art Series Chardonnay), Vasse Felix, Moss Wood, Cullen
slides.2.points.4: Despite representing only 3% of national output — produces ~20% of Australia's premium wine
slides.3.title: Leeuwin Estate: Margaret River's Showpiece
slides.3.points.0: Art Series Chardonnay: regarded as one of Australia's greatest whites; annual concert programme
slides.3.points.1: First major winery to prove MR could rival the world's best
slides.3.points.2: Robert Mondavi advised on establishment in the 1970s
slides.3.points.3: Also produces excellent Art Series Cabernet, Riesling and Sauvignon Blanc
slides.4.question: Why does Margaret River produce both excellent Cabernet Sauvignon reds and premium Chardonnay whites — rare for a warm Australian region?
slides.4.options.0: Because it is cold like Tasmania
slides.4.options.1: The Mediterranean climate with cooling Indian and Southern Ocean sea breezes creates warm, dry summers ideal for Cabernet while retaining enough freshness for elegant Chardonnay
slides.4.options.2: Both varieties were planted on the same block
slides.4.explanation: Margaret River enjoys a unique climate: warm Mediterranean summers (ideal for fully ripening Cabernet Sauvignon) moderated by persistent Indian and Southern Ocean sea breezes that cool the afternoons and preserve acidity. This means reds have full phenolic ripeness while whites retain elegant freshness — one of the few regions globally that excels equally in Bordeaux-style reds and Burgundy-style whites.
slides.5.title: Lesson Summary
slides.5.points.0: Margaret River: Mediterranean + ocean influence → Australia's most balanced fine wine region
slides.5.points.1: Famous for: Cabernet (structure + cassis) + SBS (Sauvignon Blanc-Sémillon) + Chardonnay (Burgundy-style)
slides.5.points.2: Only 3% of national volume but ~20% of premium wine — quality over quantity
